description: Cards display content and actions about a single subject.

tags.devx:
- `href` renders the card as a native link and always applies the interactive treatment.
- `interactive` without `href` renders `role="button"` with `tabIndex={0}` and Enter/Space activation; provide the action with `onClick`.
tags.a11y:
- Actionable cards are focusable, expose native link or button semantics, and show a visible focus outline.
- The accessible name of an actionable card comes from its content; keep meaningful text inside it.
tags.limitations:
- No built-in header/actions slots; layout is fully custom via children.
- An actionable card is one action target: do not nest interactive elements inside it; compose inner controls in a non-interactive card instead.

interactive.name: interactive
interactive.description:
Enables the actionable treatment: state layer, pointer cursor, and a
visible focus outline. Framework adapters also apply it whenever `href`
is provided.

children.name: children
children.description: Custom card content; layout is fully owned by the consumer.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

href.name: href
href.description: Navigation destination; switches the native element from div to link.

ref.name: ref
ref.description:
Ref forwarded to the native div element.

tags.devx:
- `href` renders the card as a native link and always applies the interactive treatment.
- `interactive` without `href` renders `role="button"` with `tabindex="0"` and Enter/Space activation; bind the action with `(click)`.
tags.a11y:
- Actionable cards are focusable, expose native link or button semantics, and show a visible focus outline.
- The accessible name of an actionable card comes from its projected content; keep meaningful text inside it.
tags.limitations:
- No built-in header/actions slots; layout is fully custom via projected content.
- An actionable card is one action target: do not nest interactive elements inside it; compose inner controls in a non-interactive card instead.
- `[class.x]` and `[ngClass]` bind to the `display: contents` host and have no visible effect; use `class`, `[class]`, or `classes`.

hostClass.name: hostClass
hostClass.description: Classes applied to the root element. Angular's native `class` attribute and `[class]` binding land here, merged with the component's own classes.

classes.name: classes
classes.description: Static or state-aware classes for the component's internal elements, keyed by element name.

href.name: href
href.description: Navigation URL. When defined, the component renders a native link.
